_note: TRUTH seam list for the seam-inference MEASUREMENT (yarn seams:score) — TEST DATA, not product data. Every seam physically sewn on this card at the size the live app reads, as StoredSeam rows (lib/seams anchors; resolvable on a new segmentation) or as patterns over interchangeable identical panels; rejected rows = pairs the engine tends to sew that are NOT sewn; closures = openings. `derivation` says how each row was found (the technologist’s order + the geometry + the notches), `confidence` sure / likely / unsure, `cls` the seam class the error tables are grouped by, `bucket` main / ply / lining, `anyOf` groups alternative readings of one seam. Built by `yarn seams:score build` from scripts/seams-score/truth/specs.ts; checked by eye on <metrics>/truth/<id>-flat-edges.png.
summary: SS26-008 «critical path» blazer (FIT stage, 46 pieces): two-piece back (upper BPU_* with the shoulder, lower BP_* with a centre-back vent), side panels MP_*, fronts P_* with a lapel (gorge notches), two-piece sleeves SL_INS/SL_OUT with cuff vents, collar CLR_MAIN + stand-like insert CLR_INS (two of each: upper and under collar), two-layer chest pieces SHLD_*, hip pockets in the side-front seam, an inside pocket of strips, and an asymmetric lining (left in three parts with the pocket, right in two, one back half). The card reads the shell only (lining off).
